verdict.rationale: Ollama's core value proposition is local/self-hosted execution: an install script runs it on your own machine, data never leaves the device, and it exposes a REST API plus Python/JS libraries for building on top of the self-hosted instance. Community evidence strongly corroborates real-world self-hosted use (easiest way to run LLMs locally, embedding it in products, GPU/ROCm setups) alongside some friction reports that don't contradict the self-hosting capability itself. Missing for 10: no first-party guidance on multi-user/production self-hosted deployment (e.g., clustering, auth, scaling beyond a single machine).
